text(await tools.exec_command({cmd:"cat > mhd_llm/codex/solver/cuda/LOCAL_REPAIR.md <<'EOF'
This experimental branch preserves the frozen thermo HLLD solver and adds
`local_positivity_repair=0|1` (default0), with `local_repair_max_iterations=8`
(valid1–16). It is a conservative face repair, not a pressure or density floor.
When an RK stage has any nonphysical cell, every failing cell is added to a
persistent mask for this timestep. The solver restores the original conserved
state and repeats the whole SSPRK2 step at the same dt. A face touching a marked
cell uses first-order split-GLM HLLE in both stages; other faces retain MC-MUSCL
HLLD. Each shared face has one flux, including periodic longitude. The same mask
is used for both RK stages, with new failing cells unioned on later retries.
Stalled masks or the explicit iteration cap invoke the preserved global
first-order fallback and subsequent timestep-halving safeguards. Accepted states
must satisfy strict positive density and gas pressure; no states are clipped.
The mask resets between accepted steps. This method is not claimed to be a
formal positivity proof for multidimensional GLM MHD with gravity.

The separate sources are generated explicitly by `build_local_repair.py` and
`build_local_gpu.py`; neither script changes a parent source. CPU source is
`local_cpu/mhd_solver_local.cpp`, GPU float64 reference is
`mhd_cuda_hlld_local_reference.cu`, and float32 candidate is
`mhd_cuda_fp32_async_hlld_local.cu`. Existing boundary maps, optional EMF,
thermodynamic closure and optional cone semantics are inherited. Float64 GPU
reference retains its no-cone restriction. Output/probe conventions are unchanged.

`local_repair.json` distinguishes accepted local repair from whole-domain
first-order fallback. Face counts refer to accepted RK evaluations only, whereas
HLLD interface-reason counters include rejected attempts as before.
`local_repair_histogram.csv` records both repair and global fallback per UTC day.
The existing `first_order_fallback_steps` retains the whole-domain meaning.
CPU `conservation_audit=1` independently sums all nine volume-integrated RHS
components and boundary fluxes, subtracting the explicit gravity source. It
also checks accepted RK inventory against both stage RHS integrals after
accounting for the two explicit cleaning damping operations. No conservation
audit changes state, timestep or flux calculations.

The tested 25-day24×4×24 CPU/GPU64 run is exactly identical in snapshot/probe
bytes, timestep and divergence statistics, interface counts, repair counts and
both day histograms. It uses3369 accepted steps and3707 local retries, without
global fallback. The coarse48×4×48 CPU run uses6774 steps and7538 local retries,
6606 locally repaired accepted steps, and0 global fallbacks. Only0.540% of
accepted face evaluations use low-order HLLE; maximum marked cells are85/9216.
All nine RHS conservation residuals are below1.04e−17 relative, and accepted RK
inventory residuals below1.54e−14. A mixed-flux periodic MHD contact, deliberately
including repaired seam faces, refines density L1 .001577→.000818 from128→256;
measured speed .4000525→.4000218 versus exact .4, conservation residual<2.6e−16.
A cap1 real-boundary control exercises9 explicit global fallback steps, rather
than silently persisting a failed mask.

These tests establish implementation and conservation behavior, not solar-wind
convergence. The coarse local repair changes PN incident-flux mean−9.62% and
maximum pointwise15.84% relative to the same thermo HLLD solver with global
fallback. Global field-weighted divergence increases .05204→.06649. Magnetic
accuracy and precision therefore remain separate conditions to measure on the
balanced production grids. FP32 precision results must be checked before use.
EOF","max_output_tokens":1000}));
